title: Discover Rocky Mountain National Park-Small Group Tour & Picnic
includes: Colorado's best Guides: Elite, passionate storytellers who know the history, geology, & hidden spots
Wildlife: Guides who know the seasonal patterns and meadows where wildlife is nearly guaranteed.
Curated Daily – Guides adapt each tour to weather, wildlife, and conditions for the best day.
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum age is 8 years - no children under 8 unless it has been authorized by tour operator.
Lunch is included starting May 1 - Please disclose dietary restrictions at checkout
If the weather is too bad or if it is too dangerous to drive some of the scenic roads, the guide will change the tour route
Please advise at the time of booking which pick up location is preferred

Please note that it is a possibility in the winter that the visibility is limited due to snow. We are flexible with our cancellation policy if snow is in the forecast and are happy to reschedule if weather looks better on another day.
From November to April, waterproof shoes are highly recommended. Wool socks are also recommended.

This is an sightseeing tour, NOT a hiking tour. Although we do have opportunities for self-exploration at select designated stops, please consider one of our hiking products for a more physically active experience.
The National Park Service has full disclosure regarding the days of operation for both Trail Ridge and Old Fall River Roads.
Please arrive 10-15 minutes prior to your tour start time to check in with the guide.
Guests who will be using an assistive device such as a scooter or walker, please contact us prior to your tout to ensure our vehicle has accommodating space.
If you are staying in Estes Park and are looking to be picked up there, please contact us directly to coordinate.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Climb from the streets of the "Mile High City" to Rocky Mountain National Park, on a day trip that showcases the rugged beauty of Colorado's mountains. Weave through small, historic towns and drive over alpine passes, as you scan the horizon for mountain wildlife like elk, black bears, or moose. Chance to spot local wildlife such as moose, elk, deer & eagles We take care of the day for you, so you can relax and enjoy the views Ample time at each stop to explore Comfortable upscale transportation
